title: TOEIC Listening & Reading Full Test 13
description: Đề thi đầy đủ theo cấu trúc đề TOEIC Listening & Reading của IIG Việt Nam: 200 câu, 120 phút (Listening ~45 phút audio chạy liên tục, Reading 75 phút). Chủ đề: giao hàng tạp hoá, hội chợ việc làm, bảo tàng, kế toán thuế, cửa hàng kính, đài truyền hình, công viên giải trí, tiệc từ thiện, nghiên cứu pin, tour ven biển, túi ni-lông, nông trại trên mái nhà, thư viện, cảnh quan sân vườn, thi chứng chỉ, tuần lễ nhà hàng; đủ dạng hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý, biểu đồ, chèn câu, đoạn kép và ba đoạn. Mỗi câu có giải thích tiếng Việt.

groups.transcript: In local news, Westfield University has received a fifteen-million-dollar grant from the National Energy Foundation to research new types of batteries for electric cars. The research will be led by Professor Hannah Kim, whose team has already developed a battery that charges in half the usual time. The grant will fund a new laboratory on campus and support about forty graduate students over five years. Harbor City Restaurant Week Returns

Harbor City's annual Restaurant Week will take place from February 10 to 16. More than 60 local restaurants will offer special three-course dinner menus for $35 per person. Some restaurants will also offer two-course lunch menus for $20.

This year, $2 from every Restaurant Week meal will be donated to the Harbor City Food Bank. Reservations are strongly recommended, as many restaurants sell out quickly.

Dessert (choose one): Tiramisu • Lemon sorbet

Available February 10–16, 5 P.M. – 10 P.M. Not available for groups larger than eight.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Review by Kate Ellison – February 14

My husband and I tried Lucia's Trattoria during Restaurant Week, and it was the best meal we've had in a long time. I started with the calamari, which was light and crispy, and my husband loved the tomato soup. We both had the salmon, which was cooked perfectly. The only disappointment was that the tiramisu had run out by the time we ordered dessert, so we both had the sorbet. The restaurant was very busy, but the staff were attentive. I'm glad some of our money went to a good cause!
